Start your engines for a high-octane death race across the Multiverse! Swerve through three planes of mayhem, dodging dangerous obstacles and rival racers along the way. Crew up unique vehicles and mounts as you discover which racing team best suits your style, then hit max speed to claim the gold.

Play Boosters are one of the best ways to play Magic with friends. Play Boosters are great for building powerful decks, fun to open, and are balanced for Limited play. Each Play Booster contains at least one shiny foil card. A full display of Play Boosters will get you off to the races!

Plus, each Play Booster Display contains a 2-card First Place Box Topper.

Contents:
30 Aetherdrift Play Boosters; each Play Booster contains 14 Magic: The Gathering cards
2-card First-Place Box Topper
